<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-cli.mjs from `skillpouch --help`. Do not edit; run `pnpm --filter @skillpouch/docs gen:cli`. -->

```text
Sync your AI assistant skills, agents, MCP servers and instructions across every computer, end-to-end encrypted

Usage: skillpouch [COMMAND]

Commands:
  login      Connect this computer to your SkillPouch account
  logout     Forget this computer's keys and tokens
  status     Show the account and device this computer is connected to
  sync       Sync this computer's pouch now
  conflicts  Open the web app to pick versions of items changed in two places
  select     Choose what this computer syncs: assistants and kinds, on or off. Without options, lists the current choice
  unlink     Stop syncing one assistant, or this whole computer. Every file stays, as a real file instead of a link
  daemon     The background sync that keeps this computer up to date
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help     Print help
  -V, --version  Print version
```

In an interactive terminal, `skillpouch` without a command opens the dashboard: it signs this computer in through your browser the first time, then helps you choose a pouch and assistants. Piped or in a script it prints a short summary and the commands to try.

Exit codes: `0` success, `1` error, `2` wrong usage, `3` not logged in, `130` cancelled.

## Commands

- [`skillpouch login`](/cli/login/): Connect this computer to your SkillPouch account
- [`skillpouch logout`](/cli/logout/): Forget this computer's keys and tokens
- [`skillpouch status`](/cli/status/): Show the account and device this computer is connected to
- [`skillpouch sync`](/cli/sync/): Sync this computer's pouch now
- [`skillpouch conflicts`](/cli/conflicts/): Open the web app to pick versions of items changed in two places
- [`skillpouch select`](/cli/select/): Choose what this computer syncs: assistants and kinds, on or off. Without options, lists the current choice
- [`skillpouch unlink`](/cli/unlink/): Stop syncing one assistant, or this whole computer. Every file stays, as a real file instead of a link
- [`skillpouch daemon`](/cli/daemon/): The background sync that keeps this computer up to date
